items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 45:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the clothing of the NHY of Ima in the Nukva? The Mochin of the Nukva, at the time that she is face to face with ZA, come by the clothing of the NHY of ZA in the Mochin of the Nukva. For she receives the Mochin from the coupling made in the head of ZA upon the Malchut of Ima, which is not included in the Mochin of ZA, as is known. But the Mochin of the back of the Nukva, she receives from the coupling of Aba and Ima upon the MAN of the Mazalot. And it is found that the NHY of Ima become Mochin for the Nukva, and not the NHY of ZA. See above, Answer 6. (Item 118).
